name: Sidea Semiconductor Equipment (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
summary: Sidea Semiconductor Equipment (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of semiconductor-specific equipment in China and internationally. The company offers wafer probe stations, die probe stations, AOI products, sorters, test handlers, bonders, and exposure machines; automated testing, semiconductor test, and LED test solutions; and support services. Its products are used in integrated circuits, optoelectronic chips, discrete devices, third-generation semiconductors, and other applications.
